sections.body: TechHub is a teaching online store for home appliances, built as a master's project. It shows the whole retail cycle: catalog, cart and payment, warehouse and purchasing, till sales, returns and warranty, analytics.
Nothing is actually sold here: prices, products and orders are demo data.
This is a teaching project, so there is no phone line or office.

sections.heading: Questions about an order
sections.body: Your order status is in My orders. You can also file a return or a warranty claim there; the store replies on the claim.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Pickup from the showroom is free. Nova Poshta, courier or another carrier is paid to the carrier on receipt, at their rates; it is not part of the order total.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Online by card through Stripe at checkout, or at the till in the showroom. Promo codes are applied in the cart before paying.

sections.heading: Timing
sections.body: Orders ship once paid. Delivery time depends on the carrier and the city.

sections.heading: Returns
sections.body: Unused goods in their original look and packaging can be returned within 14 days of receipt. Money goes back to the card you paid with; in-store purchases are refunded in cash.

sections.heading: Warranty
sections.body: Each product page and order shows the warranty period (usually 12 months). Faulty goods are repaired, replaced or refunded.

sections.heading: How to claim
sections.body: Open the order in My orders and choose Return / warranty next to the item. The claim status is shown there too.

sections.heading: How do I order?
sections.body: Add products to the cart, go to checkout, enter your contacts and delivery method and pay by card. No account needed.

sections.heading: How much is delivery?
sections.body: Pickup is free. Other methods are paid to the carrier on receipt.

sections.heading: How can I pay?
sections.body: By card online (Stripe) or at the till in the showroom.

sections.heading: Can I return a product?
sections.body: Yes, within 14 days of receipt, from My orders.

sections.heading: What warranty do I get?
sections.body: It is shown on the product page; you can file a claim from My orders until it ends.

sections.heading: Who writes reviews?
sections.body: Only buyers who received the product. The rating is the average of their scores.

sections.heading: General
sections.body: By using the site you accept these terms. The site is a teaching project: orders create no real obligation to sell.

sections.heading: Account
sections.body: You can order as a guest or with an account. You are responsible for keeping your password safe; turning on two-factor authentication is recommended.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
sections.body: Prices are in hryvnias. The price at checkout applies; promo discounts are shown in the cart.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Showroom pickup is free; other delivery is paid to the carrier on receipt.

sections.heading: Returns and warranty
sections.body: Returns within 14 days of receipt, warranty claims until the product's warranty ends, both from My orders.

sections.heading: Reviews
sections.body: Buyers who received a product can review it. The store may hide reviews that break the law or are not about the product.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Name, email, phone and delivery address when you sign up or check out; your history of orders, claims and reviews.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: To fulfil and deliver orders, handle returns and email you about order status. Marketing emails only if you agreed at sign-up.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
sections.body: Stripe for card payments (we never receive card details), an email service to send messages, and the carrier gets the recipient details for delivery. Nobody else.

sections.heading: What others see
sections.body: Reviews show your first name only, never your surname or email.

sections.heading: Protection
sections.body: Passwords are stored only as hashes, and store staff see data according to their role.
